summary: Slim PLATE PR template: Summary, What changed, How verified, Links, and Visual evidence with gh --attach guidance; repo and template_payload copies stay aligned.
migration_impact: Adopters should import or refresh PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md (--strategy safe overwrites taxonomy/templates). Author/reviewer models use list lines under Agent review models.
migration_guidance: Run gh plate import-payload --dry-run then --apply with --strategy safe to refresh the PR template, or merge the updated file manually.
Use gh pr create|edit --body-file and --attach for screenshots; do not commit images.
Fill Author model and Reviewer model list lines when pr-gates reviewer-model warnings apply.
agent_notes: PR bodies follow the slim section layout; Visual evidence is optional with an explicit N/A line when no UI changed.
